items.source: Builds and returns a new VectorStore instance with the configured settings.
items.translation: 构建并返回一个具有配置设置的新 VectorStore 实例。

items.source: Sets the distance type for vector similarity calculations.
items.translation: 设置向量相似度计算的度量类型。

items.source: Sets whether to force vector normalization.
items.translation: 设置是否强制向量归一化。

items.source: Sets the index type for vector storage.
items.translation: 设置向量存储的索引类型。

items.source: Sets the map name for vector storage.
items.translation: 设置矢量存储的地图名称。

items.source:
Provides a fluent API for configuring all aspects of the Coherence vector store,
including map name, distance type, and indexing options.
items.translation: 提供用于配置 Coherence 向量存储所有方面的流畅 API，包括地图名称、距离类型和索引选项。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if distanceType is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 distanceType 为 null

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if indexType is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果 indexType 为 null

items.source: mapName - the name of the map to use
forcedNormalization - true to force normalization, false otherwise
items.translation: forcedNormalization - 强制归一化为 true，否则为 false
